name: @singularityrd/aidr-codex
description: Singularity AIDR Codex PreToolUse hook and central policy handoff

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/ensure-core-build.mjs && node ../../scripts/rmrf.mjs dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && node esbuild.config.js && tsc && pnpm run sync:assets
scripts.build:release: node ../../scripts/ensure-core-build.mjs --release && node ../../scripts/rmrf.mjs dist tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && node esbuild.config.js --release && tsc && pnpm run sync:assets && node ../../scripts/generate-artifact-manifest.mjs --dir dist --artifact-id codex/dist && node ../../scripts/check-no-sourcemaps.mjs dist
